Generate predictions from a GradBoostR model

Source: R/gradboostr_predict.R
gradboostr_predict.Rd

Generates regression predictions, predicted classes, or class probabilities from a model fitted with gradboostr_fit().

Usage

gradboostr_predict(object, newdata, type = c("response", "prob"), ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted object created by gradboostr_fit().

newdata

A numeric matrix or data frame containing predictor values.

type

Prediction type. Use "response" for regression predictions or classification labels. Use "prob" for classification probabilities.

...

Additional arguments reserved for future use.

Value

For regression models, a numeric vector with one prediction per observation. For classification models, either a factor of predicted classes when type = "response" or a numeric probability matrix when type = "prob".
